digest.component_or_area: reconciler backend facade and jira adapter
propositions: Reconciler core must call through a named Backend interface rather than directly accessing Jira adapter modules, enabling future backends to implement the same Protocols.

Five role Protocols (TicketTransport, OutboundMapper, InboundMapper, FieldSanitizer, IdentityConvention) and three runtime-checkable capability Protocols must be defined in _backend.py, with JiraBackend delegating to existing Jira modules with zero behavior change.

IdentityConvention must be a new pure convention object under adapters/jira/ that formats RemoteRef to rebar-id label strings and parses them back, centralizing the currently inline convention from four core call sites.

Contract test suite must be backend-agnostic, parameterized to run against both JiraBackend (with injected mock transport) and FakeBackend, verifying round-trip mapping, sanitizer idempotency, and capability-guarded dispatch via isinstance checks.
Characterization tests must assert pure Jira mapper outputs are byte-identical to current main behavior, confirming JiraBackend delegation is behavior-preserving.
No core differ, apply, applier, or fetcher module is rewired in this story; all call-site rewiring is deferred to S4.
